extracted.name: Dill Dip
extracted.description: This delicious dill dip is made in a matter of minutes by combining sour cream with minced onion and parsley to deliver a fresh, garden-y kick!
ingredient_lines: 1.5 teaspoons seasoned salt, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Combine mayonnaise, sour cream, onion, dill weed, seasoning salt, and parsley together in a bowl; cover and refrigerate overnight.
